title: Quote of the day
text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Laozi

title: Quote of the day
text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
author: Confucius

title: Quote of the day
text: No one is useless in this world who lightens the burden of another.
author: Charles Dickens

title: Quote of the day
text: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
author: Emily Dickinson

title: Quote of the day
text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
author: Japanese proverb

title: Quote of the day
text: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
author: Proverb

title: Quote of the day
text: Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
author: William James

title: Quote of the day
text: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

title: Quote of the day
text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
author: Seneca

title: Quote of the day
text: Well done is better than well said.
author: Benjamin Franklin

title: Quote of the day
text: No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
author: Aesop

title: Quote of the day
text: If one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
author: Henry David Thoreau

title: You showed up
text: Today you did what you said you would. That is how every big change quietly begins.

title: Proof
text: Every checked box is evidence that you keep your word to yourself. Collect more evidence tomorrow.

title: Momentum
text: The hardest part is starting. You started. Everything after that is just continuing.

title: Zoom out
text: One day rarely changes a life. A hundred days like this one absolutely does.

title: The long game
text: You are not behind. You are building something that takes exactly as long as it takes.

title: Roots first
text: Trees spend years growing roots before anyone sees a branch. Unseen work counts.

title: Brave enough
text: Doing the thing when you didn't feel like it is the real kind of strength.

title: Better, not perfect
text: Aim for a slightly better day than yesterday. That bar is always reachable.

title: Look how far
text: Think back to a month ago. Whatever has changed since, you did that.

title: Choose again
text: Every morning is a fresh vote for the person you want to become. You voted well today.

title: Steady wins
text: Fast is exciting, but steady is what actually arrives.

title: Good things take root
text: What you water daily grows, even when you can't see it yet.
